annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it demonstrates how to create, describe, attach files to, and submit an IndianOil service request. The displayed helpdesk screens and submission controls fit an instructional complaint-management context, and the request to subscribe and like is ordinary audience engagement not tied to a financial or credential-based offer.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The central activity is an instructional demonstration of ordinary operational software use: opening a service request, entering complaint details, attaching a file, and submitting the ticket.

evidence.observation: The speaker describes adding a complaint in the helpdesk.
evidence.quote: today example we will add complaint in the helpdis

evidence.observation: The speaker instructs viewers to open the new service request option and view complaints.
evidence.quote: here you will see will be getting new service request option which is displayed in right front click on this as soon as you click on it all your complaint will be visible

evidence.observation: The speaker explains how to add a file attachment through a file-selection page.
evidence.quote: when you will add new file like this then a page will open where you want to add at a time here will open choice file

evidence.observation: The speaker instructs viewers to submit the service ticket.
The supplied frame visibly shows an IndianOil Service Requests page for a request titled "Waitlist Not clearing" with a View Attachments dialog.
The supplied frame visibly shows a Create a File Attachment dialog with a file-selection control and attachment options.
The supplied frame visibly shows a helpdesk ticket list containing a request titled "Waitlist Not clearing" with a submitted status.
The speaker refers to logging in with an ID and password.
evidence.quote: Login with your ID and Password
